subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the three guard assertions are repaired and exact-head checks pass, does the secops/workflow owner approve the refreshed privileged action revisions?
rationale: The updated actions execute with credentials, publishing authority, repository mutation access, or security-scanning permissions, so upstream validity and green CI do not replace owner acceptance.

options.title: Approve after repair
options.body: Land the verified grouped refresh after guard synchronization and exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Split privileged actions
options.body: Review token, publishing, CodeQL, and Codex revisions separately from ordinary setup actions.

options.title: Pause the refresh
options.body: Retain current pins if the privileged revisions cannot receive owner acceptance.

recommendation.title: Approve after repair
recommendation.body: Land the verified grouped refresh after guard synchronization and exact-head checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The root CODEOWNERS route assigns `.github` here, while the sensitive subset also requires secops review.
